recorded: By backend/src/analytics/index.ts buildRichIndicators and monthlySparkline at commit ba5d541b9, before issue 1751 moved them into the SDK. A null inside a number array stands for NaN.

expected.name: 10y–2y yield curve
expected.description: The difference between 10-year and 2-year US Treasury yields. When negative ("inverted"), short-dated bonds yield more than long-dated ones — a configuration that has historically preceded every US recession since 1955.

expected.name: Real 10y yield
expected.description: The yield on 10-year Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS) — the "real" interest rate after stripping out inflation expectations. The pure cost of capital that policymakers actually care about.

expected.name: 5y breakeven inflation
expected.description: The bond market's implied forecast for average inflation over the next 5 years. Computed as the spread between nominal 5-year Treasury yield and 5-year TIPS yield.

expected.name: HY OAS credit spread
expected.description: ICE BofA US High Yield Option-Adjusted Spread. The yield premium that investors demand to hold US junk-rated corporate bonds over Treasuries. A direct, real-time measure of credit risk appetite.

expected.name: DXY (trade-weighted USD)
expected.description: A broad trade-weighted index of the US dollar against the currencies of major US trading partners. Measures dollar strength globally, not just against the major reserve currencies.

expected.name: Initial jobless claims
expected.description: The number of new claims filed for US unemployment insurance benefits in the most recent week. The cleanest high-frequency read on labor market health.

expected.name: VIX
expected.description: CBOE Volatility Index. The market's expected 30-day volatility of the S&P 500, derived from the prices of out-of-the-money S&P options. Universally known as the "fear gauge."

expected.name: Copper / Gold ratio
expected.description: Price of copper futures divided by price of gold futures. Copper is an industrial-demand proxy (used heavily in construction, electronics, manufacturing); gold is a defensive store of value. The ratio captures whether the commodity complex is leaning cyclical or defensive.

expected.name: S&P 500 50d/200d trend
expected.description: Ratio of the S&P 500's 50-day simple moving average to its 200-day simple moving average. The classic "golden cross / death cross" trend indicator on the broadest equity benchmark.

expected.name: Equity breadth (IWM/SPY)
expected.description: Ratio of the Russell 2000 small-cap ETF (IWM) to the S&P 500 ETF (SPY). A measure of market breadth — whether small-caps are participating in the rally or just the mega-cap leaders.

expected.name: Total DeFi TVL
expected.description: Total dollar value of crypto assets locked across all DeFi protocols — lending, automated market makers, liquid staking, restaking, yield aggregators. The aggregate measure of capital deployment into permissionless finance.

expected.name: Total stablecoin float
expected.description: Total outstanding supply of USD-pegged stablecoins (USDT, USDC, DAI, and others) across all chains. Approximates the dollar liquidity sitting on crypto rails.

expected.name: BTC active addresses
expected.description: Number of unique Bitcoin addresses that participated in transactions on a given day. A proxy for organic network usage and on-chain engagement.

expected.name: ETH active addresses
expected.description: Number of unique Ethereum addresses that transacted on a given day. Equivalent to the BTC measure, for ETH mainnet specifically.

expected.name: BTC MVRV
expected.description: Market Value to Realized Value ratio. Divides BTC market capitalization by its "realized cap" — the sum of (price-at-last-move × amount) across all UTXOs. Represents how big a paper gain or loss the average bitcoin holder is sitting on.

expected.name: BTC / ETH ratio
expected.description: BTC price divided by ETH price. A proxy for "crypto risk preference" — when capital flies to the safest crypto asset (BTC) over the higher-beta major (ETH), risk-off is happening within crypto.

expected.name: ETH 50d/200d trend
expected.description: Ratio of ETH's 50-day simple moving average to its 200-day SMA. The ETH-specific equivalent of SPX_TREND.

expected.name: New DEX pools (24h)
expected.description: Count of new DEX liquidity pools (≈ new token launches) observed across all networks in the trailing 24 hours. A real-time measure of crypto speculation intensity.

expected.name: DeFi TVL growth (90d)
expected.description: The 90-day percent change in total DeFi TVL. Captures flow — whether capital is actively expanding or contracting the on-chain ecosystem — independent of where the absolute level happens to be.

expected.name: Stablecoin float growth (90d)
expected.description: The 90-day percent change in total stablecoin float. Captures whether dollar liquidity on crypto rails is expanding or shrinking — a leading indicator of imminent risk-asset deployment or withdrawal.

expected.name: High-beta vs low-vol
expected.description: Ratio of the Invesco S&P 500 High Beta ETF (SPHB) to the Invesco S&P 500 Low Volatility ETF (SPLV). Both are S&P 500 subsets, so the ratio isolates the risk-axis directly without cross-cap or sector confounds.

expected.name: Momentum factor
expected.description: Ratio of the iShares MSCI USA Momentum Factor ETF (MTUM) to the S&P 500 ETF (SPY). Captures whether cross-sectional momentum — buying recent winners — is working in the current market.

expected.name: Growth vs value
expected.description: Ratio of the iShares Russell 1000 Growth ETF (IWF) to the iShares Russell 1000 Value ETF (IWD). Captures the high-duration / risk-asset side of the equity style axis.

expected.name: Utilities leadership
expected.description: Ratio of the SPDR Utilities Select Sector ETF (XLU) to the S&P 500 ETF (SPY). Utilities are the canonical defensive / bond-proxy sector.

expected.name: Staples vs discretionary
expected.description: Ratio of the SPDR Consumer Staples ETF (XLP) to the SPDR Consumer Discretionary ETF (XLY). Direct read on consumer-driven cyclical vs defensive rotation.

expected.name: Shiller CAPE (cyclically adjusted P/E)
expected.description: Robert Shiller's Cyclically Adjusted Price-to-Earnings ratio for the S&P 500 — current real price divided by the 10-year average of real earnings. Smooths the earnings cycle so the multiple is comparable across business cycles, unlike raw trailing P/E which spikes mechanically in recessions.
